connector.name: QTM4J
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for QMetry Test Management for Jira (QTM4J) Open API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package qtm4j-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the denis-platonov account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
